activity_has_a_subject.name: activity_has_a_subject
activity_has_a_subject.value: "app"."activity"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL OR "app"."activity"."opportunity_id" IS NOT NULL

contact_email_owner_uidx.name: contact_email_owner_uidx
contact_email_owner_uidx.where: "app"."contact"."email_norm" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."contact"."deleted_at" IS NULL

contact_email_idx.name: contact_email_idx
contact_email_idx.where: "app"."contact"."email_norm" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."contact"."deleted_at" IS NULL

earnings_deal_context_present.name: earnings_deal_context_present
earnings_deal_context_present.value:
"app"."earnings_ledger"."entry_type" IN ('manual_adjustment', 'projection_repair')
          OR ("app"."earnings_ledger"."opportunity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."earnings_ledger"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL
              AND "app"."earnings_ledger"."stage_name_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."earnings_ledger"."stage_config_version" IS NOT NULL)

capability_verified_needs_probe.name: capability_verified_needs_probe
capability_verified_needs_probe.value: "ref"."provider_capability"."status" <> 'verified' OR ("ref"."provider_capability"."evidence_probe_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ref"."provider_capability"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)
